gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cantarell: Beaded, expressive letters: Bruno Ace SC spreads them wide across the heading line. And Cantarell, the sans-serif beneath, keeps its arches matched to its stems, so the whole page stays approachable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-commissioner: Beaded, distinctive Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters wide, with no calligraphic thinning. Commissioner reads smoothly beneath it, with curves that never clog and strokes of uniform thickness throughout the text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-didact-gothic: Wide-set, beaded, unmistakably expressive: that is Bruno Ace SC. Didact Gothic sits beneath as a sans-serif body that never snags on a closed-up bowl, so the heading can show off.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 holds a tube-like thickness through every bend, with wide channels leading into each counter, beneath Bruno Ace SC. Give the beaded heading room to sprawl at a larger size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-encode-sans-expan: Encode Sans Expanded keeps its c tips pulled well apart, plain sans through and through. Encode Sans Expanded stays low, while the round-lettered Bruno Ace SC loses its punch if made small.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-finlandica: Beaded, expressive spacing is Bruno Ace SC all over. It earns its keep big and short, while Finlandica brings plain sans manners: open-mouthed e crossbars and a constant-width outline.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-host-grotesk: Host Grotesk sweeps its curves open instead of curling closed, beneath the bent-pipe strokes of Bruno Ace SC. Constant-width heading strokes against low-key, sweeping body curves: that tension is the draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ibm-plex-sans-ara: IBM Plex Sans Arabic reads easily, its open apertures inviting the eye along. And Bruno Ace SC, with strokes like a bent steel rod, is built to stand out in a heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ibm-plex-sans-dev: Bruno Ace SC gives its horizontals the full weight of its verticals, letters strung out like beads on a thread. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari follows with rope-loose curves that never knot.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ibm-plex-sans-tha: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace SC never swells or thins as you read. But IBM Plex Sans Thai, with c ends pointing apart like open pincers, does the quiet reading work.
